reviews.title: A little pricey but functions great
reviews.comment: I got this to go with a Corsair iCUE Link AIO and it works great! Good airflow and looks good, but I can't say that 30-40 dollars for a singular fan is a good price. If you have no need for the iCUE Link system, just get the RS120 version and a commander duo if you want fancy lighting.
